author: Doompatrol007
quote: World is ok, story ****, visually appealing and definitely some new awesome world related things. Stealing a car isn’t straight forward and a lot of the core GTA get in the game and cause havoc to anyone any where feels sanitized.. Enough of the pain points for a newly launched game make me simply disinterested. Hopefully they will reverse course and I will revisit in a couple of years.
